steps.en: Install the router and its build plugin
steps.zh: 安装路由与它的构建插件

steps.en: Register the plugin in your Vite config
steps.zh: 在 Vite 配置里注册这个插件

steps.en: Write each route as one file under src/routes
steps.zh: 每条路由写成 src/routes 下的一个文件

steps.en: Watches the folder and regenerates the typed route tree on every change
steps.zh: 监听这个目录，每次改动后重新生成带类型的路由树

steps.en: Create the router from that tree and mount it at the root
steps.zh: 用这棵树创建 router，并在根节点挂载

steps.en: Checks every link, param and search value at compile time; loaders fetch, cache and prefetch per route
steps.zh: 编译期校验每个链接、路径参数与查询参数；loader 按路由取数、缓存并预取

value.en: A mistyped link or untyped URL param now fails the compiler instead of shipping a broken page
value.zh: 写错的链接、没类型的 URL 参数，如今在编译期报错，而不是把坏页面发上线
